messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — RC-2 code freeze in ~6 hours (18:00 PT). Please avoid direct merges to main. Target release/rc-2 for any last-minute fixes. If you need a late-merge exception, post reason + owner + CI status here.

Alex: Need a late merge exception for a tiny docs + version bump (pkg versions). No code changes, just changelog and package.json bump. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/5179. CI green except flaky lint job that passed locally.

Devon: @Alex can you paste the exact changelog line and bump commit? Want to confirm it won't change behavior across deploys.

Alex: changelog: "fix: update supported GPU instance note". Commit: `bump(pkg): 1.12.3 -> 1.12.4` (no runtime code).

Sarah: Is the lint flake reproducible? If it's just whitespace, can we fix in PR and re-run? We try not to open exceptions for lints.

Alex: It was a transient ESlint cache error in CI. Re-running should be fine. I can push a quick no-op whitespace fix if needed.

release-bot: REMINDER: release/rc-2 branch protection enabled at 17:45 PT. Late merge exceptions require at least one core approver + release manager sign-off.

Kunal: @Alex can you do the whitespace push and re-run CI? If CI is green and @Sarah or @Devon LGTMs, I can approve exception. Also include a smoke test checklist run and screenshot.

Alex: Pushed whitespace fix, CI rerun triggered: https://ci.internal/builds/rc-2/6821 (running).

Devon: LGTMed quick look — docs-only and bump. Approving.

Sarah: Quick thumbs up — docs + version bump ok from me too.

Kunal: Exception granted. Requirements for this exception: 1) squash-and-merge with commit message `chore(release): 1.12.4` 2) post smoke test steps+output in PR comments 3) tag release-ops for rollback runbook. Merge window extended by 30m (until 18:30 PT) for this change only.

Alex: Thanks all — will squash and merge after CI finishes and post smoke results.

Alex: Smoke steps I ran: `./scripts/smoke-check.sh --config rc-2` -> all checks pass, small timing bump for inference-test but under threshold. Pasted logs snippet: ```
OK  inference-test: p99=120ms p95=68ms
OK  api-auth: all endpoints 200
```

Kunal: Received smoke logs, looks good. @release-bot please note exception id EX-2026-rc2-08 by Kunal for audit.

release-bot: Exception recorded: EX-2026-rc2-08. Merged by Alex at 2087654387.

Maya: Thanks team — keeping the window tight helped. If anyone else expects a tiny changelog or docs bump, follow the same flow (whitespace fix, CI green, 1 core approver, smoke run). :thumbsup:
